faqs.question: Do I need a doctor's referral?
faqs.answer: In many cases you can book directly, but requirements can vary depending on your insurance or claim. Contact the clinic if you are unsure.

faqs.question: Do you accept ICBC claims?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you have an active ICBC claim from a motor vehicle accident, you may be able to access up to 12 weeks of treatment with us — conditions and eligibility apply. Bring your claim number and our team will help you get started.

faqs.question: Can I book online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the Book Now button to book through Jane online booking.

faqs.question: Which service should I choose?
faqs.answer: If you are not sure what to book, contact the clinic and the team can guide you toward an appropriate starting point.

faqs.question: Do you offer direct billing?
faqs.answer: Direct billing options may be available. Please confirm your provider and coverage with the clinic before booking.
